verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk and centred, with large empty white side bands, and the cloud's right edge looks clipped where it meets the white. It isn't a real resize for the banner shape, but the photo, cloud, headline and subline all stay intact and in the right order. B pushes the photo into the top-left corner and leaves the right ~60% of the canvas empty, the cloud shape is broken into fragments, and 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' runs past the image and cloud onto the bare white. That makes it lopsided and visibly broken.
